notice: These are newly derived, unvalidated educational observations. The source supplies no printed answer key for this exercise. They are unscored and require qualified ECG educator review.

fields.value: Eleven sharp positive peaks with variable height are separated by many uneven low-amplitude oscillations. Some peaks have small negative returns. Baseline oscillations are not counted as additional ventricular complexes or named as atrial waves.
